Summary
: The Ramayana Engish translation presents an important literary masterpiece originally authored by Valmiki at least 2500 years ago. The legendary epic revolves around the Rama as he attempts to rescue his wife Sita who was forcefully abducted by Ravana, the king of Lanka.
The Ramayana was written in roughly 24,000 Sanskrit metrical verses spanning seven books or Kandas (Adi or Bala-kanda, Ayodhya-kanda, Aranya-kanda, Kishkindhya-kanda, Sundara-kanda, Lanka-kanda and Uttara-kanda)
Other titles include: Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa (वाल्मीकि रामायण) or Vālmīkirāmāyaṇa (वाल्मीकिरामायण)
